_meta.purpose: Curated catalog behind the National and International source picker (assets/news-picker.js). Parallel to local-stations.json (places) and topic-sources.json (topic tabs).
rules: FREE TO READ, full stop. No meter, no subscribe wall on ordinary news articles. Donation asks and optional memberships are fine; a metered or 'premium' article mix is not. Readers tap through from a headline, and a paywall on the other side is a broken promise.
Current. A source has to post most days. Low-volume outlets are welcome but should be honest about it in their blurb; the picker's peek measures volume live anyway.
Blurbs say what an outlet IS, in its own terms (e.g. 'libertarian magazine'). No ratings, no lean scores — those belong to other organisations and are contested.

Verify every feed through the proxy before adding, counting item AND entry (see local-stations.json _meta.howToAdd), and check the newest item's date: CNN's feed parses perfectly and hasn't updated since 2023.

schema.sources: [ { id, name, rss, site, scope: national|international, beats: [..], regions: [..] (international only), kind, blurb, default? } ]
schema.beats: general | politics | accountability | business | science | human-interest | sports
schema.regions: global | europe | middle-east | africa | asia-pacific | americas
schema.kind: public (public broadcaster or state-funded) | nonprofit | commercial | wire
schema.default: true on the six per scope a new visitor starts with. These MUST match DEFAULT_CONFIG.widgets in assets/common.js, which can't wait on a fetch.

excluded._why: Checked and left out, so nobody re-adds them. Date is when the decision was made.
